premises.text: Businesses need to verify customer identities to prevent fraud and keep information safe
premises.evidence_span: merchants. They need to know that Emily is who she says she is, and once they've confirmed that she is who she says she is, they need to keep her information safe.

premises.text: Sidditchi allows two parties to confirm that their information is the same without exchanging it
premises.evidence_span: Sidditchi is patented software that allows two parties to confirm that the information that they have is the same without ever exchanging the information.

premises.text: The process of verifying identity can be done without sharing sensitive information
premises.evidence_span: No information left my browser. No information left the server in the bank.

premises.text: Organizations can convert verified identity attributes into the Sidditchi format for access through an identity exchange
premises.evidence_span: get organizations that hold lots of verified identity attributes on us to convert that information into the Sedici format, make it available on servers

premises.text: The verification model is transactional, charging a fee for each verification while sharing revenue with information providers
premises.evidence_span: Every verification we do, we charge a fee for. But the interesting thing is we give 30% of that back to the provider of the information.

premises.text: Real-time monitoring of transactions can reduce fraud and improve identity verification speed
premises.evidence_span: the prevention of fraud, which is real-time monitoring of credit card transactions, and the identity verification area.

value.text: Identity verification can be fast, secure, and efficient for businesses and consumers
value.evidence_span: we want to bring those two things together and make it fast and accurate.
